package main

import "runtime"

type Obj struct{ data [512]byte }
type Holder struct{ Ref *Obj }

var keep *Obj

func main() {
	func() {
		o := &Obj{}
		// Correct: the cleanup argument tells the cleanup nothing about o.
		runtime.AddCleanup(o, func(n int) { _ = n }, 42)
	}()
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
}
